_about: Code 128 vectors for packages/printer/labels/code128.ts. Encoding rule (screens/20): all-digit values of length >= 2 use Start C (105) with digit pairs, and a trailing odd digit is sent as Code B (100) + the digit; every other value uses Start B (104). check = (start + sum(i * value_i)) mod 103, then Stop (106). modules_incl_quiet = bar/space modules including the 2-module stop bar end and a 10-module quiet zone on each side. Every vector was rendered and decoded back with zxing-cpp (the engine behind zxing-wasm) on 27 Oct 2026.
